summary: Host Digital Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 2,187,500 Class A common shares at $8.00 per share, raising $17.5M gross ($16.275M net) before a 30-day option for 328,125 additional shares. The $8.00 offer price sits about 29% below the September 17, 2026 last sale of $11.33. Cantor leads, with Siebert, A.G.P. and Clear Street as joint book-runners; closing expected on or about September 21, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and use of proceeds.
